decks.notes: The strategy of this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells and removing threats with efficient removal spells like Shock and Bonecrusher Giant. Gadwick, the Wizened provides card draw and disruption, while Brineborn Cutthroat and Brazen Borrower offer tempo plays and pressure. Ral's Outburst can be used for removal or as a finisher. The mana base allows for flexibility in casting spells and activating Castle Vantress for additional card selection. The deck aims to out value the opponent and control the game until it can secure a win condition.

The deck focuses on using powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Nissa, Who Shakes the World to control the game and generate card advantage. Cards like Mass Manipulation and Time Wipe help to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Hydroid Krasis provide additional threats and ways to gain card advantage. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes utility lands like Castle Vantress. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through a combination of control elements and powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to apply pressure on the opponent quickly by playing efficient threats like Gilded Goose, Cauldron Familiar, and Mayhem Devil. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Witch's Oven and Oko, Thief of Crowns while also generating card advantage with cards like Once Upon a Time and Korvold, Fae-Cursed King. The deck utilizes a combination of ramp, removal, and powerful creatures to overwhelm the opponent and secure a victory through aggressive plays and board control.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence and controlling the game with counterspells and flash creatures. By using efficient creatures like Wildborn Preserver and Nightpack Ambusher, along with disruptive spells like Sinister Sabotage and Quench, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent while also having the ability to protect its own threats. The inclusion of cards like Once Upon a Time and Fabled Passage allows for consistent early game plays and ensures that the deck can operate smoothly.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by ramping up mana with cards like Nissa, Who Shakes the World and Paradise Druid, while also using powerful planeswalkers like Liliana, Dreadhorde General and Oko, Thief of Crowns to dominate the board. The deck also includes removal spells like Noxious Grasp and Wicked Wolf to handle threats from opponents. The goal is to outvalue the opponent with card advantage and strong creatures like Hydroid Krasis, while maintaining control of the game through a mix of planeswalkers, removal, and powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using Fires of Invention to cast spells for free. It includes a variety of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Narset, along with board wipes like Deafening Clarion. The deck also utilizes Fae of Wishes to search for specific answers from the sideboard, giving the player flexibility and adaptability in different matchups. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to establish board control, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and ultimately win through a combination of powerful planeswalker abilities and efficient spellcasting.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with efficient and powerful creatures. By utilizing cards like Lovestruck Beast, Questing Beast, and Venerated Loxodon, the deck aims to attack aggressively and maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes support cards like Gideon Blackblade and Conclave Tribunal to control the board and protect its creatures. Overall, the deck is designed to apply early and consistent pressure to win the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Growth Spiral and Circuitous Route to allow for the casting of powerful spells with Fires of Invention. It utilizes Fae of Wishes to fetch specific cards from the sideboard to deal with different threats or situations. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Deafening Clarion and Time Wipe while generating card advantage and life gain with Hydroid Krasis. Golos, Tireless Pilgrim serves as a versatile threat and mana fixer, while Kenrith, the Returned King provides additional utility and recursion.

The main focus of this deck is to play aggressively with a combination of powerful Simic creatures and planeswalkers. By ramping up quickly with Gilded Goose and Paradise Druid, the deck aims to play threats like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Nissa, Who Shakes the World early on to pressure the opponent. Hydroid Krasis provides card advantage and life gain, while Questing Beast and Voracious Hydra offer additional aggression and resilience. Overall, the key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats while disrupting their game plan with cards like Brazen Borrower.

The main focus of this deck is to rapidly deal damage to the opponent through aggressive and efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Fervent Champion, supported by burn spells like Shock and Skewer the Critics. Torbran, Thane of Red Fell amplifies the damage output of all red sources, while Runaway Steam-Kin helps generate mana for explosive turns. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and relentless assault, utilizing cards like Light Up the Stage to maintain card advantage and push towards a swift victory.

The deck focuses on using Fires of Invention to cast powerful spells for free, while also controlling the game with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Deafening Clarion. The deck includes a mix of card draw, removal, and powerful threats like Cavalier of Flame and Cavalier of Gales. The goal is to control the game until you can overwhelm the opponent with your powerful creatures and spells, using Fires of Invention to cheat mana costs and outvalue your opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and utilizing sacrifice effects to gain value from them. The key strategy revolves around creating a loop with Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Mayhem Devil to deal incremental damage while drawing cards with Midnight Reaper. Claim the Firstborn and Angrath's Rampage provide additional control by stealing or destroying opposing creatures. The mix of direct damage spells like Light Up the Stage and removal spells like Bedevil ensure that the opponent's board stays clear while the Rakdos Aggro engine keeps pushing for victory.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game by using removal spells and powerful planeswalker abilities to gradually overwhelm the opponent. The deck includes a mix of threats and answers, with cards like Cavalier of Dawn and Seraph of the Scales providing both offensive capabilities and defensive options. The inclusion of cards like Liliana, Dreadhorde General and Doom Foretold allow the player to generate advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the Orzhov Control archetype aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on utilizing Adventure creatures to establish a strong board presence and apply pressure on the opponent quickly. Cards like Edgewall Innkeeper and Lovestruck Beast are used for card advantage and efficient early game threats, while Nissa, Who Shakes the World and Garruk, Cursed Huntsman provide ramp and powerful late-game potential. Removal spells like Murderous Rider and Vraska, Golgari Queen help control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful planeswalkers.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence and dealing damage to the opponent by playing aggressive creatures and using adventure cards for value. The key strategy is to utilize the "Adventure" mechanic to generate card advantage and tempo advantage, while also using efficient removal spells like Assassin's Trophy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to swarm the battlefield with creatures and apply pressure early in the game, while maintaining card advantage through the use of cards like Midnight Reaper. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.
